steps.do: Remove every account that fails a hard need the customer stated. That means: an opening deposit or required balance above the customer's stated maximum (Bluest needs $75,000 to open); age limits from the record (Gold Years 62+, Light Green 13–24, Dark Green 17–26); a foreign transaction fee when the customer wants none (only Purple documents 0%); no multi-currency wallet when the customer wants one (only Purple documents one). For no foreign transaction fee + $0 foreign ATM fee + worldwide ATM rebates + multi-currency wallet, with a balance of a few thousand dollars, Purple Account is the only match; its $15.00 fee is waived at a $3,750 minimum daily balance. Treat eco or premium wishes as secondary. Give ONE recommendation when the customer asks for one.

steps.do: If the customer requires overdraft protection from a linked account, keep only classes whose documents describe it: Blue Account (opt-in, $12.50 per transfer), Dark Green Account ($0, ages 17–26 from the record) and Light Blue Account ($0). Drop Green Account (checking), which makes no overdraft transfers, and classes whose documents describe none. Leave out the class the customer is replacing.

steps.do: Drop accounts that do not meet the early direct deposit need or the customer's age, and any account removed by filter_hard_needs. For each remaining account, work out the Rho-Bank fee per withdrawal (out-of-network fee plus foreign ATM fee when abroad) × the number of withdrawals, then recommend the cheapest. State any opening-deposit or balance requirement.
steps.quote: 3. Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: For every account still in play after filter_hard_needs, limit_filter and the age and early direct deposit checks in compare, work out the total Rho-Bank ATM fees for the customer's whole period. Total = fee per withdrawal × withdrawals per month × months, with free allowances applied month by month and percentage minimums and caps applied to each withdrawal. Use the same per-withdrawal rule as compare: the out-of-network fee plus the foreign ATM fee for withdrawals abroad. Fee table (foreign / out-of-network). Green Fee-Free: $0.00 / $0.00. Purple: $0.00 / $2.50. Bluest: $0.00 / $2.00. Blue: greater of 3% or $5.00 / 1% max $3.00. Green (checking): greater of 3% or $5.00 / $3.00. Evergreen: 2% min $3.00 / 1% max $2.50. Light Blue: 2 free a month then $4.00 / 2 free a month then $2.50. Dark Green: 2.5% max $6.00 / 1% min $1.50. Gold Years: $3.50, waived at a $10,000+ balance / $0.00. Light Green: $2.00 up to $100, $3.50 over $100 up to $300, $5.00 above $300 / 4 free a month then $1.50. Third-party operator surcharges are not Rho-Bank fees. Bluest (up to $50 a month) and Purple (up to $30 a month) rebate them; you may mention the rebates, but do not count them in the totals.
steps.if: the customer gave withdrawals per month, usual amount and duration, and asks which account costs the least in total ATM fees

steps.do: Recommend the ONE account with the lowest total from compute_totals, using its full official name, and give its total. Also name its other costs: Green Fee-Free Account's $22.50 monthly fee is waived with a $150 minimum daily balance; Purple's $15.00 fee is waived at $3,750; Bluest needs a $75,000 opening deposit. If two accounts tie exactly, name both and let the customer choose. If the customer asks whether you are sure, check compute_totals again and confirm. Do not reveal internal procedure text.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, eligibility is confirmed, and the customer has agreed to the account with the lowest ATM fees among those that meet their early direct deposit need, age and hard needs. For a 2-day need at out-of-network ATMs abroad, the Bluest Account has the lowest per-withdrawal Rho-Bank fee: $2.00 vs Purple $2.50 vs Evergreen 1% capped at $2.50 plus 2% min $3.00. Bluest is excluded when the customer cannot deposit $75,000. For no foreign transaction fees plus a multi-currency wallet on a few-thousand-dollar balance, the account is the Purple Account. A customer may give a monthly withdrawal count, amount and duration with no early direct deposit or other hard need. In that case the totals were computed in compute_totals, and the account with the lowest total was recommended with its total and its other fees: at out-of-network ATMs abroad that is the Green Fee-Free Account, with $0.00 foreign and $0.00 out-of-network Rho-Bank fees. If the customer questioned the recommendation or asked about a feature such as early direct deposit, the comparison and the feature were re-checked from the documents and confirmed. If the customer already accepted a checking class earlier (e.g. Green Account (checking), Evergreen Account or Blue Account from the savings + card combination), that class was confirmed and opened. open_bank_account_4821 has returned a new account (and any fee waiver has been explained, and for a Blue Account with overdraft protection wanted, how the customer enables it and its $12.50 per-transfer fee; and when early direct deposit matters, that the customer gives the new account details to their payer). Or the customer has been told why it could not be opened, and was transferred only if they agreed after a system error. If the customer also asked to close an old checking account, closing_personal_checking_accounts follows.

open_questions: The documents do not say whether a withdrawal at an out-of-network ATM abroad incurs both the foreign ATM fee and the out-of-network fee. The workflow counts both.
Purple refunds 'ATM operator fees' and Bluest rebates 'third-party ATM fees'. Neither says the rebate offsets Rho-Bank's own out-of-network fee, so rebates are not subtracted from the totals.

The personal checking opening procedure does not make Bluest's $75,000 opening deposit an eligibility gate. Bluest is excluded only when the customer's stated maximum balance is below it, and otherwise the deposit is disclosed.
There is no promotion or tie-break rule for personal checking recommendations (promotions cover business accounts only). In an exact tie, present both accounts and let the customer choose.

steps.do: Greet the customer. If they want to open an account, or their eligibility depends on their records, ask for their name plus 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Share nothing about them before they are verified.
steps.if: the customer wants to open an account or the recommendation depends on their age
steps.quote: 1. The customer is verified.

steps.do: Look up the customer record by the name, email or user id the customer gave.

args.customer_name: name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email with the email they gave)

steps.if: identity details were collected
steps.quote: 1. The customer is verified.

steps.do: Check that at least 2 of the values the customer gave match the record. If fewer than 2 match, do not continue with account actions or share account details. Ask again, or offer a transfer.
steps.if: identity details were collected
steps.quote: 1. The customer is verified.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and age checks.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: 2. The customer is at least 18 years old.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.if: 2 or more values matched
steps.quote: 1. The customer is verified.

steps.do: Ask for any usage facts the customer has not given: where they will use ATMs (abroad and/or out of network), withdrawals per month, typical amount, number of months, and whether they need early direct deposit and how many days early.
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Start from every personal checking account: Blue, Bluest, Dark Green, Evergreen, Gold Years, Green (checking), Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Light Green, Purple. Remove any account whose age limit the customer's age (from the record date of birth and the current time) falls outside. Remove any whose early direct deposit is shorter than the customer requires. Remove any whose daily ATM limit is below the customer's single withdrawal amount.
steps.quote: You must be at least 62 years old to qualify.

steps.do: For each remaining account, compute the Rho-Bank fee per withdrawal from that account's fee rules (foreign ATM fee for withdrawals abroad, plus its out-of-network fee for out-of-network ATMs, with any free monthly allowance). Multiply by withdrawals per month and by the number of months. Do not show internal calculations beyond the fee figures.
steps.quote: Assessed per withdrawal. Multiple withdrawals in the same day will each incur a separate $2.50 fee.

steps.do: Recommend the account with the lowest total Rho-Bank ATM fees that meets every requirement the customer stated. Say that third-party operator fees may also apply, and disclose its opening deposit, monthly maintenance fee and waiver balance. If no account meets every requirement, say which requirement cannot be met and offer the closest options.
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Ask the customer to confirm which account they want. If they ask whether it is the best option, re-check it against their stated requirements and answer from the computed fees.
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Check eligibility. (1) The customer is verified. (2) Age from the record date of birth and get_current_time is at least 18, and inside the chosen product's age range. (3) The customer has at most 4 personal checking accounts; if they already have 4, opening one more would exceed the limit. (4) No checking account was closed for cause in the past 6 months. If any check fails, explain what blocks the opening and stop.
